gate_title: Canonical suite topology and heavyweight-assurance remediation

canonical_assurance: standalone legacy unittest complete repository suite
pytest execution of exact legacy unittest population
globally serialized stable-main final merge readiness

proposed_authority_delta.decision_scope: Authorize a bounded runner-neutral deterministic required-shard candidate and shadow benchmark programme for the current legacy unittest population.
authorised_after_pass: create a versioned deterministic shard manifest/registry derived from the exact legacy unittest-discovered population
partition that population across bounded parallel shadow jobs with exact-one membership and deterministic ordering
add union-completeness, no-duplication, no-omission and deterministic-repeatability proofs
run the shard candidate in shadow beside all existing required checks
measure exact-head shard critical path, runner overhead and repeatability
prepare a coordinated cutover packet compatible with PYT-G2 or an explicit superseding operator decision
not_authorised_by_this_pass: remove, skip, demote or replace standalone unittest
remove, skip, demote or replace pytest-unittest-parity or runner-parity
admit pytest-native tests into the canonical surface
enable pytest-xdist or any unordered process-parallel runner
change benchmark freshness, scientific evidence semantics or heavy-test assertions
activate the shard candidate as a substitute for any existing required check
change merge authority or stable-main readiness semantics
grant scientific, semantic, Validation, selector, publication, probability, risk, exposure or execution authority

alternatives.reason: Potential speedup but changes process topology/order and overlaps PYT-G2 runner/surface admission. Current plain pytest parity execution is slower than unittest on main.
Preserves every current test and runner contract while proving whether parallel shard topology can reduce the eventual critical path before any cutover.
Highest governance risk because it changes when heavyweight scientific/evidence workloads are required and what complete assurance means.

acceptance_conditions_after_operator_pas: all currently required tests/checks remain required throughout shadow evaluation
shard manifest is deterministic from a pinned exact-head legacy unittest population
every legacy unittest case belongs to exactly one shard
union cardinality and identities equal the legacy unittest loader population with zero omissions and zero duplicates
repeated manifest generation is byte-identical on the same head
each shard is independently reproducible and fails closed
shadow aggregate result equals canonical required-check outcome on the same head
no heavy-test assertion, benchmark population, capacity N set, GOLDEN2 output contract or topology determinism assertion is weakened
performance evidence reports actual critical path and runner overhead without treating estimates as measurements
rollback leaves existing required CI fully intact
any later required-check substitution/removal waits for PYT-G2 or an explicit superseding operator decision
warnings: Current aggregate suite has increased to 140 seconds; audit-baseline per-heavy timings are historical and not fresh individual benchmarks.
Shadow sharding will not itself reduce merge latency while the existing full legacy/parity checks remain required; it supplies the proof needed for a later coordinated cutover.
PYT-G2 remains the governing standalone-unittest cutover boundary unless explicitly superseded by the operator.
rollback: If DEFER/BLOCK, keep current main CI unchanged and retain this evidence. If PASS and the later shadow candidate fails, remove/supersede only shard manifests, shadow jobs and candidate tooling; preserve existing tests, required checks, PYT policy, stable-main readiness and all historical evidence. Never force-push or rewrite history.
exact_work_after_approval: create a fresh bounded implementation branch from then-current lawful main
reconcile any main movement using the PDC policy before modification
materialise a versioned legacy-test identity census and deterministic shard registry
implement shadow parallel shard execution without changing current required checks
run targeted, full canonical, PYT parity and shadow shard checks on exact heads
benchmark at least three repeat runs on stable comparable heads where practicable and report critical-path/runner-overhead distributions
correct defects inside scope without weakening tests
if acceptance passes, prepare the coordinated PYT-G2/cutover evidence; do not activate substitution/removal without the authority required by PYT-G2 or an explicit superseding operator decision
